lines.en: Excuse me, Ms Clark. Do you have a minute?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，克拉克老师。您有空吗？

lines.en: Of course, Emma. What's up?
lines.zh: 当然，艾玛。怎么了？

lines.en: I was absent yesterday because I was ill. How can I catch up?
lines.zh: 我昨天生病缺课了。我怎么才能补上？

lines.en: I'm sorry you were ill. Here's the worksheet from yesterday's class.
lines.zh: 很遗憾你生病了。这是昨天课上的练习纸。

lines.en: Thank you. Also, could I have an extension on my essay?
lines.zh: 谢谢。另外，我的作文可以延期交吗？

lines.en: Yes, you can hand it in next Monday instead.
lines.zh: 可以，你可以改为下周一交。

lines.en: That's really helpful. I'm also struggling with the grammar in unit three.
lines.zh: 这真帮了大忙。我还觉得第三单元的语法很难。

lines.en: Why don't you come to my office hours on Thursday? We can go through it together.
lines.zh: 你星期四来我的办公时间吧？我们可以一起过一遍。

lines.en: Great. What time?
lines.zh: 太好了。几点？

lines.en: Three thirty, in Room 20.
lines.zh: 三点半，在20教室。

lines.en: Thank you so much, Ms Clark.
lines.zh: 太感谢您了，克拉克老师。

lines.en: Mr Brown, could you give me some feedback on my essay?
lines.zh: 布朗老师，您能给我的作文提些意见吗？

lines.en: Sure. Your ideas are really interesting, and your story is clear.
lines.zh: 当然。你的想法很有意思，故事也很清楚。

lines.en: Thank you. What can I improve?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我哪里可以改进？

lines.en: Watch your past tense. You wrote "I go to the park yesterday."
lines.zh: 注意过去时。你写了"I go to the park yesterday"。

lines.en: Oh, it should be "I went to the park yesterday."
lines.zh: 哦，应该是"I went to the park yesterday"。

lines.en: Exactly. Also, try to use more linking words, like "however" and "because".
lines.zh: 没错。另外，试着多用一些连接词，比如"however"和"because"。

lines.en: OK. Should I rewrite it?
lines.zh: 好的。我需要重写吗？

lines.en: Yes, if you like. I can check it again next week.
lines.zh: 你愿意的话可以。我下周可以再帮你看看。

lines.en: I'll do that. Thanks for your advice!
lines.zh: 我会的。谢谢您的建议！
